title: Häme Castle
scope: Present-day Häme Castle in Hämeenlinna, including the central keep and open court, ring and bailey buildings, crown bakery, roofed gate and round cannon tower. The separate Prison Museum, nearby artillery museum and peripheral landscape are outside the model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum identifies the surviving castle as a square fieldstone castle later enlarged above in brick and surrounded by outer defenses.
The written conservation study describes the ring buildings, crown bakery, gate and archaeological transitions. Photographs and drawings in this document were excluded.
Named native castle relation and adjacent native geometry from the retained map bundle.

limitations: Roof pitches, ridge intersections, tower elevations, chimney placement and window heights are visually estimated from the cleared exterior photographs and published building accounts.
The original terrain is untouched. Building floor elevations are estimates and the native terrain represents two-metre relief.
The castle reconstruction omits interior rooms, freestanding peripheral defenses and modern neighboring museum buildings.
